name: Mystical Frog
lore: Fattened on swamp-magic and far too clever. Novices laugh at it once, then learn to respect the slam.

source.prompt: Green mystical frog. This is a level 1 enemy, but it still look dangerous.

attack.source_name: Slams both hands on the ground. Powerful attack mo

die.source_name: Turns into dark green slime and dissapers
